# TeoAds — CPA Affiliate Network (Betting & Gambling)
> TeoAds is an iGaming affiliate network aggregating 100+ affiliate programs
> with 500+ CPA and RevShare offers across 50+ GEOs in betting and gambling verticals.
> Weekly payouts, personal account managers, public offers API.
> Founded in 2022, headquartered in the Cyprus.

## Offer catalog
- [All offers](https://teoads.com/offers): Full live catalog with filters by GEO, vertical, and traffic source
- [Betting offers](https://teoads.com/offers/betting): Sportsbook affiliate programs live catalog
- [Gambling offers](https://teoads.com/offers/gambling): Online casino affiliate programs live catalog

## Public API
Open API for partners and integrations:
- Base URL: https://api.teoads.com/v1/network/
- Authentication: not required for public catalog
- Format: JSON

The API and live catalog are the source of truth.
